subject: WS53 MSUB explicit 32-bit SDK access views
source_facts: clock_recover.h defines MSUB_NOR_CFG and MSUB_SLP_CFG at these addresses.
clock_recover.c ccore_switch_pll_clock and acore_clock_recover.c switch_clock_from_ch0_to_ch1, switch_clock_from_ch1_to_ch0 and ccore_switch_xo_clock call reg_setbit/reg_clrbit on these slots.
chip_io.h defines reg(base, offset) and reg32(register) as volatile uint32_t lvalues; the original macros perform word read-modify-write.
pm_sleep_porting.c has two reg32_setbit(MSUB_SLP_CFG, 0x0) calls; the oracle executes that original access statement with an anonymous-host-RAM address.
Application normal/sleep gate and selector positions come from the compiled hal_clocks.h application enums. The normal enum has no MBUS_CLKEN member; no normal bit2 field is invented.
export_contract: Existing 16-bit register names, fields, addresses, access and unknown reset metadata remain unchanged.
Only two alternateRegister views are added, both size32 with the same low-half fields. Upper-half fields are not invented and RMW preserves sampled upper bits.
The exporter requires explicit evidence, aligned vacant upper halfwords, RW fields, unknown resets, no side effects and no arrays; both slots satisfy these checks.
The exporter does not require both access widths to have independently qualified silicon writes. Historical halfword views are retained for compatibility, not newly qualified.

host_validation.source_identity: Every input equals git show of the pinned SDK commit before compiling.
host_validation.allocation: Anonymous MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_32BIT host RAM only; no /dev/mem, device or physical fixed mapping.
assertions: sizeof original reg and reg32 lvalues equals4
19 original SDK enum field positions equal both SVD views
42 helper cases preserve all unrelated low/upper bits and neighboring words
CCORE clock helper clears selector before the two stub delays and restores it afterward
limits: switch_ch_clock and cpu32m_udelay are explicit stubs; no clock timing or hardware behavior is inferred
SDMA/MDMA gate writes are not exercised by these host helper cases

generation_baseline: Immediately preceding local RDL snapshot already contains the separate uncommitted Flash mapping work; this delta does not attribute those changes to MSUB.

historical_readback_context.conclusion: Both earlier accesses retained SDMA bit4. This is not evidence that changing access width clears the gate, and the cause remains unqualified.
